SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.positionOrder >= 12
GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, average_laps DESC
LIMIT 10;
